children: Overview
Hong Kong banking group's H1 profit attributable to equity holders rose 7.1% yr/yr
Net operating income before impairment allowances fell 0.6% yr/yr on lower FX product values
Company declared a special dividend and approved a three-year shareholder return programme
Outlook
BOC Hong Kong plans to deliver at least HK$10.5 bln in additional shareholder returns by 2028
Company says Hong Kong's economy maintains expansionary growth momentum with steady recovery in consumption and property
Result Drivers
FX PRODUCT VALUATION - Co said lower mark-to-market values for FX-related products reduced net operating income before impairment allowances
NET INTEREST MARGIN - Co said strengthened deposit pricing and growth in CASA deposits contributed to year-on-year increase in net interest margin
FX TRADING DECLINE – Net trading gain fell 44.2%, due to fewer FX swaps as more funding was deployed in local currency and weaker valuations

Analyst Coverage

Wall Street's median 12-month price target for BOC Hong Kong Holdings Ltd is HK$52.00, about 4.4% above its August 27 closing price of HK$49.82
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
